title: Baked Potatoes and the Potato Bar
description: Russet baked potatoes (oven or microwave) plus a lighter-style potato bar.

ingredients.item: cheese: shredded mozzarella, shredded habanero jack, grated parmesan

ingredients.note: potato bar, see R7; warmed with a splash of broth, on the side

ingredients.item: ranch, candied jalapenos, salt and pepper

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F (Bake mode; Air Fry mode at 400°F also works and runs a little faster).
Scrub, dry well, poke each potato 5 or 6 times with a fork. Rub with oil and coarse salt.
Place directly on the middle rack with a sheet pan on the rack below to catch drips.
Bake 50 to 65 min (Air Fry mode: about 45 to 55 min) depending on size.
Done when a fork slides in with no resistance and it gives when squeezed (with a mitt). Inside about 205 to 210°F.
Potato bar: split the potato, fluff the inside with a fork, butter first, then toppings. Pop back in the microwave 20 to 30 sec to melt cheese if needed.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R15
notes:
Microwave shortcut: scrub and poke all over. Microwave on a plate: 5 min for 1 potato, flip, then 2 to 4 min more. Add about 3 min per extra potato. Done when soft when squeezed. Rest 2 min. Want crispy skin? Rub with oil and salt, finish 8 to 10 min in the oven on Air Fry mode at 425°F.
Storage: fridge 3 to 4 days (cool, then fridge; don't leave wrapped in foil at room temp); freezing not great. Reheat: microwave 1.5 to 3 min, cut open halfway. Or oven 375°F 15 to 20 min for crisp skin.
